verdict.rationale: Formant's ReadMe-hosted reference embeds full OpenAPI 3.0.0 JSON for each endpoint in its markdown mirror ("Formant admin-api"), so a machine-readable spec does exist. However, the complete spec is not downloadable: the ReadMe OAS download is admin-gated, api.formant.io serves no spec paths, and probes of standard openapi.json/swagger.json paths all return 404. Users can only assemble the spec endpoint by endpoint. Missing for 10: a single publicly downloadable full OpenAPI document, a standard discoverable spec URL, and independent hands-on corroboration of using the per-endpoint mirrors.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Formant's ReadMe-hosted reference publishes machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.0 definitions per endpoint: every endpoint page's markdown mirror embeds that operation's full OpenAPI JSON
The complete spec is not downloadable: the ReadMe OAS download is admin-gated and api.formant.io serves no spec paths
